inspection.visual_review: Upstream screenshot shows glass-front commercial refrigerator with a separate door frame and left-side handle. Metadata confirms distinct door subtree. No new render was produced during curation.

intended_joint_task.description: Turn the preserved refrigerator visualization into a physically constrained one-DOF door assembly without changing source mesh topology or deleting source data. Use the case as fixed rigid body and the complete FridgeDoor subtree as the moving rigid body.
intended_joint_task.task_goal: A force or torque pulse opens the door while the hinge holds its anchor, the cabinet remains fixed, and a limit stops the door. This must be physics motion rather than source animation playback.

protocol_caveats: No physical properties have been authored during curation.
Do not count the existing 4.67-second keyframe animation as physical success.
Angle limits, inertial assumptions, impulse magnitude, time step and tolerances must be frozen by root before paired arms.
Collision approximations should preserve the visible source geometry and should be reported separately from source meshes.
